# Build coworker+friend email set from phone contacts
pw=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
phone_pw=[x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_access_token=apis.phone.login(username='3379617841', password=phone_pw)['access_token']

contacts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    contacts.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

# relationships are strings like 'coworker','friend'
allowed_relationships={'coworker','friend'}
contact_emails=set()
for c in contacts:
    rels=c.get('relationships',[]) or []
    rels_l={str(r).strip().lower() for r in rels}
    if rels_l & allowed_relationships:
        email=c.get('email')
        if email:
            contact_emails.add(email.lower())

print('contact_emails_count', len(contact_emails))
print('sample_emails', sorted(list(contact_emails))[:20])

# Fetch pending requests again
venmo_pw=[x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_access_token=apis.venmo.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

pending=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    pending.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

# Filter by sender email
target_ids=[]
target_senders=[]
for r in pending:
    sender=r.get('sender',{})
    se=sender.get('email')
    if se and se.lower() in contact_emails:
        target_ids.append(r['payment_request_id'])
        target_senders.append((r['payment_request_id'], sender.get('name'), se, r.get('amount')))

print('pending_count', len(pending))
print('target_ids_count', len(target_ids))
print('target_ids', sorted(target_ids))
print('target_senders')
for x in sorted(target_senders, key=lambda t: t[0]):
    print(x)

# Approve only filtered pending payment requests
pw=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
venmo_pw=[x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_access_token=apis.venmo.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

target_ids=[3798, 3803, 3804, 4168, 4169, 4170, 4173, 4174, 4176, 4917, 5467, 5469, 5764, 5767, 5768, 5771, 5772, 5966]

results=[]
for pr_id in target_ids:
    try:
        resp=apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(payment_request_id=int(pr_id), access_token=venmo_access_token)
        results.append((pr_id,'ok',resp))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((pr_id,'fail',str(e)))

ok=[r for r in results if r[1]=='ok']
fail=[r for r in results if r[1]=='fail']
print('approved_ok_count',len(ok))
print('approved_fail_count',len(fail))
if fail:
    print('failures:',fail)

# Verify approved by checking pending list no longer contains target IDs
pw=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
venmo_pw=[x['password'] for x in pw if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_access_token=apis.venmo.login(username='paul_mill@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

target_ids=set([3798, 3803, 3804, 4168, 4169, 4170, 4173, 4174, 4176, 4917, 5467, 5469, 5764, 5767, 5768, 5771, 5772, 5966])

pending=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    pending.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

pending_ids=set([r['payment_request_id'] for r in pending])
print('pending_remaining_target_hits', sorted(list(target_ids & pending_ids)))
print('pending_total', len(pending))

# Fetch approved list to ensure they appear
approved=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, status='approved', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    approved.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

approved_ids=set([r['payment_request_id'] for r in approved])
print('approved_contains_target_hits', sorted(list(target_ids & approved_ids)))
print('approved_total', len(approved))
